author: claude
summary: Task 002 of the voice-card-consolidation plan: folds MetadataEditorModal.tsx's form content into the Overview tabpanel (task 001's VoiceDetailTabs) as inline, always-editable content -- no modal, no focus trap. Save logic (api.patchVoiceMetadata) and required-fields (class/gender/age) gating are reused verbatim. MetadataEditorModal.tsx itself is kept (VoicesPage.tsx's catalog-card flow still uses it) but its VoiceLabPage.tsx call site, and the header's now-dead 'Edit metadata' trigger, are removed.

files.change: New component: same state shape/handlers as MetadataEditorModal (attrs, tags, description, languages, iconPath, saving, error, iconError), same handleSave -> api.patchVoiceMetadata(voice.id, patch), same requiredMissing gating. Renders IconUpload, description textarea, languages input, OneSelect x5, ManySelect x6, TagsInput, error banner, and an explicit Save button -- no dialog chrome, no useFocusTrap, no Escape handling. Explicit-Save (not autosave-on-change) was chosen and documented in the file's header comment: no debounce infra exists, autosave-per-field-change would spam PATCH calls, and would lose the single commit point needed to surface 422 errors cleanly.

Removed MetadataEditorModal import/usage and the metadataEditorOpen state; wires OverviewTab (with the same untagged-voice metadata fallback the modal used) as the Overview tabpanel's content, passing handleMetadataSaved as onSaved. Removed the onEditMetadata prop passed to VoiceDetailHeader.

Removed the onEditMetadata prop and the 'Edit metadata' button (Pencil icon) -- metadata is now always editable inline in the Overview tab, so there is nothing left for the header trigger to open. Documented in the file's header comment.

Replaced the 'opens MetadataEditorModal when Edit metadata is clicked' test with one asserting the Overview tab's fields (description, Save button) are visible inline by default and that no 'Edit metadata' button or dialog exists. Updated the tabs-placeholder-content test to assert the Overview description field instead of the retired 'Overview content coming soon.' text. Added api.patchVoiceMetadata to the module's api mock.
